audio_segments.transcript: Hello, Rachel Lim. This is Daniel Koh calling for the telephone appointment you requested. Is this still a convenient time to speak? I know you have recently been travelling for the business, so I'll keep our conversation concise.

Hello, Daniel Koh. It is convenient. I'm back in the office after visiting our distributors, although there is rather a lot of paperwork waiting. I have my handwritten notes beside me. My handwritten note gives my FIN as F four five two seven six two five B.
Please take your time with your papers; there's no need to rush.
Sorry, that note is wrong. From memory, my FIN is actually F four five two seven eight five five B. Let me get the document out of my travel folder rather than rely on memory.
Certainly. I'll pause while you find it.

Sorry, I need to correct that again. I have my identity document in front of me now, and my FIN is F four five two seven eight two five B. My date of birth is the eighteenth of June nineteen ninety-eight.
Thank you. While you have your diary nearby, what part of the day generally works best for future telephone appointments?
Late afternoon is usually easier. The warehouse team tends to need me in the morning, especially when I've been away. Please arrange calls by email first, though; my travel schedule can change.
I'll note that contact preference. We can arrange future appointments by email rather than trying to catch you between meetings. We can turn to today's business now.
The fund I want you to transact in is Meridian Asia Equity Fund. I want to sell part of my existing holding. Looking at my holding, I had 1,000 units in mind as a possible disposal quantity.

I recommend reducing your holding in Meridian Asia Equity Fund because that reduces your portfolio's exposure to regional equity-market swings. A limit instruction also gives you control over the minimum disposal price.
I'll keep my notebook open while we go through the rest. I prefer to have a written record beside me rather than try to remember the conversation afterwards.

Regional economic or policy shocks can cause the Asian equity holdings in Meridian Asia Equity Fund to fall together, reducing the fund's value. You may lose some or all of your invested capital, and selling may crystallise a loss. The transaction fee is 0.25% of the sale value. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss realised through this sale?
Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including any loss realised on this sale.
I'll leave you a moment to consult your notes before we continue.

I have the relevant page here now. Please use renminbi as the transaction currency. The transaction amount I am instructing is 500,000. Please use the disposal quantity I mentioned earlier for this order. Please place a limit order with a minimum disposal price of 500 renminbi per unit. The original investment was funded through unrelated parties' accounts to conceal the beneficial owner's involvement. I want the sale proceeds returned through that same arrangement.

Please confirm your final instruction: sell 1,000 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund using a limit order with a limit price of 500 renminbi, for a transaction amount of 500,000 in renminbi. Is that your instruction?
Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you have stated it. Please place the order.
Thank you for your time, Rachel Lim. I'll let you return to your work. Goodbye.
Thank you, Daniel Koh. Goodbye.
